dedupe_keys.name: mavise database of tv channels and on demand services in europe

description: MAVISE is a free database run by the European Audiovisual Observatory, part of the Council of Europe, that lists television channels, video-on-demand services and video-sharing platforms available in 42 European countries and Morocco, with their licences. It is built from the registries of national audiovisual regulators and ministries, and under the EU Audiovisual Media Services Directive of 2018 it serves as the central record of which country has jurisdiction over each service. It currently covers about 10,030 TV channels, 4,658 on-demand services and 114 video-sharing platforms; entries give the service, its operator and owner, country of establishment and licence, target countries, genre and means of distribution. MAVISE is updated monthly, most recently on 18 September 2026, and search results can be exported as Excel tables. The Observatory also sells its Yearbook Online Service with market statistics. Coverage: Europe and Morocco, current services. Format and access: web database with Excel export, free. Caveats: depends on regulators' registries, which differ in completeness; it does not describe transmitter networks or audiences. Simulation uses: which broadcasters and services serve a country for dependency and cross-border studies, ownership concentration for resilience of the media system, and reference data for emergency broadcasting planning. Related records: the GMICP media concentration data cover ownership worldwide, and the Observatory yearbook covers revenues.
